events.text: The map's first cross is a gorge where the river runs underground for a mile. The way in is a crack behind a waterfall, and the water comes down hard enough to break a careless back.

choices.text: Read the water and go in at the slack

ok.log: You wait a day and a night for the rhythm of it, and go in between two falls. Behind the water there are steps cut by a hand.

fail.log: You misread it. The water throws you back into the pool, and you crawl out bruised.

choices.text: Go through by strength

ok.log: You go through like a post through a flood, and come out on the far side on steps cut by a hand.

fail.log: The water wins this time. You come out half drowned.

choices.text: Mark the place and come back another year

effects.log: You fold the map. The waterfall will be there.

events.text: The second cross is a hall cut in the rock, and its floor is a board of a hundred herbs set in clay. A physician of long ago left a note on the wall: whoever would learn to mend must first know what kills.

choices.text: Name the herbs, one by one, aloud

ok.log: You name them. Ninety-seven are medicine and three are poison, and you step around the three. The far door opens.

fail.log: You name a poison as a cure, and the hall fills with a bitter smoke that takes a week to leave your chest.

choices.text: Trust your nose and walk the safe herbs

ok.log: Your nose is honest. You cross without a single wrong step, and the far door opens.

fail.log: One wrong step, one bitter cloud. You stagger back out to the steps.

choices.text: Copy the board, and study it a year first

effects.log: You copy every herb by lamplight and leave to study. The board will wait.

events.text: The third cross is a small dry room with a cauldron in it, cold for two hundred years, and a sealed box. The note on the box says it opens only for one who has kept a fire steady through a whole night.

choices.text: Light the cauldron and keep it steady till dawn

ok.log: At dawn the box opens by itself. Inside, on silk gone brown: the Pill of the Mended Well, every step, in a careful hand.

fail.log: The fire jumps at the third hour, and the box stays shut. You will have to come back.

choices.text: Feed the fire with your own qi, all night

ok.log: Your qi holds the fire like a hand around a candle. At dawn the box opens, and the recipe is inside.

fail.log: Your qi gives out before the dawn. The box stays shut.

choices.text: Rest first. Come back stronger

effects.log: You leave the cauldron cold. It has waited two hundred years.

events.text: The chart's first mark is the underside of a drifting isle, where its roots hang into the open sky. The way in is a climb up through the roots with nothing below you but cloud.

choices.text: Read the wind and climb between the gusts

ok.log: You climb with the wind, never against it, and come up into a hollow where steps are cut into the isle.

fail.log: A gust takes you off the roots. You catch the cloud-road a long way down, shaken.

choices.text: Climb straight up by strength

ok.log: You go up through the roots hand over hand, and come into a hollow with steps cut into the isle.

fail.log: Your grip goes. You fall to the cloud-road and climb no more that year.

choices.text: Mark the isle and come back another year

effects.log: You note the isle's drift. It will come round again.

events.text: The second mark is a hall of a hundred cloud-herbs grown in jade pots, left by a healer of the Isles who went down a thousand years ago and never came back up. A plaque says: learn what harms before you learn what mends.

choices.text: Name the cloud-herbs aloud

ok.log: You name them all, and three you leave well alone. The far door slides open.

fail.log: You touch a harmful one, and your hand goes numb for a season.

choices.text: Trust your nose among the pots

ok.log: Your nose is honest. You cross the hall untouched.

fail.log: One wrong breath. You wake on the steps outside.

choices.text: Copy the pots, and study a year first

effects.log: You copy every pot onto a jade slip and leave to study.

events.text: The third mark is a cold furnace of white jade and a sealed slip-case. It opens, says the plaque, for one who keeps a cloud-fire steady from dusk to dawn.

choices.text: Keep the cloud-fire steady till dawn

ok.log: At dawn the case opens. Inside, on a slip of jade: the Pill of the Mended Well, every step.

fail.log: The cloud-fire gutters in the small hours, and the case stays shut.

choices.text: Hold the fire with your own energy, all night

ok.log: Your energy holds the fire. At dawn the case opens, and the recipe is yours.

fail.log: Your energy gives out before dawn. The case stays shut.

choices.text: Rest first. Come back stronger

effects.log: You leave the furnace cold. It is used to waiting.

events.text: The chart's first hall is the gate of a fallen healer-god's temple, at the edge of a domain nobody tends. The gate is guarded by its god's last prayer, still burning, which lets in only those who mean to heal.

choices.text: Speak the prayer back to it

ok.log: You speak it back, word for word, and mean it. The flame bows, and the gate opens on a stair.

fail.log: You stumble on the last line. The flame scorches you back down the steps.

choices.text: Walk through the flame and bear it

ok.log: You walk through it and it does not burn what it was made to keep out. The stair beyond is open.

fail.log: The flame was right about you, this year. You come out singed.

choices.text: Mark the temple and come back in a better year

effects.log: You mark the gate in your chart. A dead god's temple is patient.

events.text: The second hall holds a hundred offerings of herbs from a hundred worlds, still fresh on their altars. A carving says: the healer who does not know poison is a poisoner.

choices.text: Name each offering, and its harm

ok.log: You name them all, and the three that kill. The inner door opens.

fail.log: You reach for a killing one. Your hand burns black for a season.

choices.text: Let your divine sense find the safe path

ok.log: Your sense is true. You cross the hall, and the inner door opens.

fail.log: Your sense misleads you. You are carried out by the temple's own wind.

choices.text: Copy the altars, and study an age first

effects.log: You copy the altars into your memory and go. They will keep.

events.text: The last hall holds a furnace of starlight, cold since its god fell, and a sealed tablet. It opens for one who keeps the star-fire steady through a whole night of the gods.

choices.text: Keep the star-fire steady through the night

ok.log: At dawn the tablet opens: the Pill of the Mended Well, every step, in a god's own hand.

fail.log: The star-fire wavers before dawn. The tablet stays sealed.

choices.text: Feed the fire with your own divine power

ok.log: Your power holds the fire. At dawn the tablet opens, and the recipe is yours.

fail.log: Your power runs thin before dawn. The tablet stays sealed.

choices.text: Rest first. Come back stronger

effects.log: You leave the furnace cold. Its god will not mind.
